_comment: Demo answers for beat 2 — document Q&A with no key and no quota.
CLAUDE.md rule 2: the system a reader runs must never need paid inference.
Beat 1 reads its SQL from queries.json and then EXECUTES it for real, so the
data is genuine and only the model output is canned. This is the same shape:
RETRIEVAL RUNS FOR REAL because embeddings are local and free, and only the
answer text is replayed. So the citations a reader sees are genuinely what
retrieval returned, not a stored list pretending to be one.
Every answer below was PRODUCED BY THE REAL MODEL and copied verbatim from
writes. Nothing here was written by hand — a demo answer nobody measured is
a claim, and this file would be the easiest place in the repo to hide one.
Keyed by question and as_of, because the date is the variable beat 2 is
about. A question asked at a date not listed here has no demo answer, and
the API says so rather than serving the nearest one.

RE-RECORDED after retrieval_answer.md gained the instruction-vs-disagreement rule. A replayed answer produced by a prompt the repo no longer ships is a demo showing behaviour the live path would not reproduce, so these move with the prompt or they are lying quietly.
